criteria.intent: Publish the source-backed architecture, limitations and ordered model handoff.
criteria.automated_scope: Current navigation/coupling and ownership checks only. Semantic design review and the live Draft PR/artifact linkage are separately recorded at the issue.

criteria.intent: Assemble incoming content from the unchanged fractal using its painted camera.
criteria.automated_scope: Planning-only: no fragment projection exists and no geometry or depth acceptance is claimed. Add named implemented spatial checks before evaluating the feature.

criteria.intent: Show mixed sub-glyph, glyph, word and picture fragments with an exact native handoff.
criteria.automated_scope: Planning-only: no new fragmentation or native-paint fidelity test exists. Add partition/image/text tests and actual visual evidence before implementation acceptance.

criteria.intent: Preserve route, landing, interruption and lifecycle continuity.
criteria.automated_scope: Existing Basic flight/theme/archive checks preserve the unchanged current source. They do not exercise a future fragment transaction; its implemented race/landing/cleanup checks remain required.

criteria.intent: Preserve semantic content, accessible controls and ordinary fallback behavior.
criteria.automated_scope: Existing Basic source checks only; fragment accessibility, disabled modes, cleanup and actual browser fallback are unimplemented and cannot pass from this policy.

criteria.intent: Keep bounded fragment resources and pass original plus predeclared added-cost budgets.
criteria.automated_scope: Planning-only: proposed bounds are not implemented or measured. Resource/measurement validators and exact-source raw paired evidence must be added before admission.

criteria.intent: Deliver reviewed implementation, mapped evidence and reconciled issue/PR state.
criteria.automated_scope: Current RI, coupling, issue-owner selection and manual-pending runner behavior verify this handoff infrastructure only. No feature implementation, independent review, merge or release is inferred.

G-DESIGN.description: Evaluate the versioned source-backed design, explicit limitations, source/PR/issue linkage, tasks and model-role recommendation. This is design self-analysis, not independent implementation review. Record the actual planning-deliverable decision at AC01.

G-DEPTH.description: Implementation is pending. Require real scene-projected fragment behavior and meaningful source tests, plus source-bound forward/reverse visual depth acceptance with unchanged scene geometry/camera/ribbons.

G-FIDELITY.description: Implementation is pending. Require real mixed-mask text/image coverage tests, final native layout and pixel/fidelity observations at Day/Night desktop/narrow sizes. Missing images or generic letter-only motion cannot satisfy this gate.

G-NAVIGATION.description: Implementation is pending. Add and run actual fragment transaction/retarget/landings/readiness/cleanup checks, then inspect matching hosted navigation observations. Existing legacy checks are insufficient.

G-ACCESSIBILITY.description: Implementation is pending. Check final semantic/native behavior, inert inaccessible visual copies, focus, announcements, no duplicate live identities, Off/reduced/hidden/print/failure and zero retained fragment resources.

G-PERFORMANCE.description: Implementation is pending. Validate declared resource bounds and same-source old/new raw paired observations at unchanged scene quality against original and predeclared added-cost budgets. No measurements were made in this planning session. Existing production/native release gates stay with issue13.

G-DELIVERY.description: Require implemented deterministic mappings, canonical/generated/offline/RI outputs, scoped current-source CI/preview/evidence, honest independent implementation review, author visual acceptance, actual issue checkboxes and applicable maintainer merge decision. Planning-only publication cannot satisfy full delivery; no production authorization is supplied.
